title: Spawn enemies by cloning a prototype
description: Enemy has a clone() method that should return a deep copy. An EnemySpawner holds a prototype Enemy and calls clone() each time it spawns a new one. Implement clone() on Enemy so that mutations to a spawned copy never affect the prototype or any other copy.
hints: clone() should return a new Enemy with the same field values
The weapons list must be copied — sharing the same list reference means mutations leak between copies
EnemySpawner is provided; you only need to implement Enemy.clone()
issues: Constructing each enemy from scratch requires repeating all configuration at every spawn site
Sharing mutable state between enemies causes unintended side effects when one is modified
overallGoal: Use the Prototype pattern so EnemySpawner can produce independent Enemy copies from a single configured prototype, with no shared mutable state between them.
goals: clone() returns a new Enemy instance with identical field values
Modifying a clone's weapons list does not affect the prototype
Each spawned enemy is an independent object
